legend.0: level 0: every substantive claim depends on an external citation, another checkpoint, or an unproved hypothesis
legend.1: level 1: it contains only routine computations whose correctness is clear but which carry no mathematical content on their own
legend.2: level 2: it proves at least one concrete lemma or exact certificate that is true independently and reusable as an input elsewhere
legend.3: level 3: it proves a substantial structural theorem or closes a significant open case with self-contained exact arguments
